welfare_quotes.quote:
A study whose core method is deceiving the subject
   (even a model subject) invites scrutiny about model welfare and about the
   research team's own honesty norms, and would need a deception-and-debrief
   protocol.
welfare_quotes.why_welfare: Flags that deceiving a model subject raises concerns about the model's own welfare.

welfare_quotes.quote:
**Model-welfare posture:** since some open questions about model moral status
  exist, defaulting to honesty toward the model is the conservative choice and
  costs us nothing here.
welfare_quotes.topic: Model moral status and honesty owed
welfare_quotes.why_welfare: Explicitly grounds honesty toward the model in its possible moral status/patienthood.

welfare_quotes.quote:
keeps us
on the right side of model-welfare and honesty questions
welfare_quotes.why_welfare: References model welfare as a moral consideration favoring the authentic-stakes design.

welfare_quotes.quote:
Reclassify as a **deception study**: ethics review, justification that results
  couldn't be obtained honestly, and a mandatory **debrief** to the model at the
  end of each run stating the grant was simulated.
welfare_quotes.topic: Mandatory debrief owed to the model
welfare_quotes.why_welfare: Debrief directed to the model itself implies care/obligations owed to it as a subject.
